drill_rig.name: Drill Rig
drill_rig.appearance: A bulky, industrial rig with a reinforced frame, exposed mechanical arms, and glowing vent panels. Its drill assembly protrudes from the front, surrounded by armored plating and hydraulic tubing.

refinery_node.name: Refinery Node
refinery_node.appearance: A compact processing node with stacked, modular tanks and a ring of coolant conduits. Its matte gray casing is punctuated by glowing circuit accents and vented exhaust panels.

salvage_processor.name: Salvage Processor
salvage_processor.appearance: A rugged processing unit with a wide intake funnel, conveyor loops, and plated armor panels. Its exterior shows welded seams, grated vents, and caution stripe markings along the edges.

ore_survey_node.name: Ore Survey Node
ore_survey_node.appearance: A compact sensor mast cluster mounted over a reinforced base. It uses rotating scanner rings and exposed relay cabling to map rich extraction seams.

ore_washer.name: Ore Washer
ore_washer.appearance: A heavy refining basin with layered filtration drums, intake grates, and broad slurry channels built into an armored frame.
